boundary_rules: Pure readers, extractors and calculators receive bytes/values; no I/O, models, job invocation or resource choice.
Acquisition and same-run custody belong to existing API launch/results episodes.
Every result is a new validated record; input arguments are not mutated.
Raw bytes remain in retained content bindings; parser documents preserve native tokens and source locations.
JSON is an internal data contract, not model-facing TASK or STEERING.
This proposal is not authorization to edit shared files or declare a tool complete.

reused_types.Evidence: existing SourceEvidence content binding plus JSON pointer; no inferred identity from filename
reused_types.NumericCell: existing bvbrc_alignment_values.numeric_cell; semantic relationships validated by provider

BackboneDocument.header: raw header+source location+ordered member index tokens

GenomeAlignmentInputs.member_bindings: native ordinal namespace -> genome occurrence + file/entry occurrence with evidence[]
GenomeAlignmentInputs.contig_bindings: file+record -> sequence_id+accession.version+genome occurrence with explicit evidence[]

ArtifactAssociations.artifacts: ArtifactBundle artifact member + exact role + observed format + task/byte-version provenance[]
ArtifactAssociations.native_member_joins: explicit native namespace -> invocation member mapping with evidence[]
ArtifactAssociations.bbcols_interval_joins: explicit bbcols internal interval -> XMFA block with evidence[]

Sheet.primary_documents: discriminated XMFADocument | MauveV4Document array, each retaining own identity

Selection.document_selections: explicit document IDs + member occurrence IDs + block/segment/sidecar row IDs + column indices[]
Selection.coverage_bases: represented | multi_member_block | cooccupied_column | v4_explicit_segments | backbone_selected_rows | bbcols_selected_ranges[]
Selection.coordinate_queries: explicit observed column or native position queries[]

Components.xmfa_components: unaltered typed neutral XMFA alignment/coverage/coordinate outputs[]
Components.aggregates: optional placement-weighted counts/fractions with preserved operands[]
